searchText: I would expect both clients to be backward compatible for a while before removing `v`, which means upgrade order shouldn't matter. However, no fix is authored yet so can't say for sure what they will do. The OpenRPC format that is used for the API spec is, unfortunately, quite limited in it's ability to include metadata information about types/fields. 😢 We can try and get rid of the transaction data structure in our next release, it would solve the issue on our end. A consensus node doesn't have any use for the transaction internals for its core duties
